reviews.text: Good vet and you're well received. Great for animals.
Very friendly team. I've finally found a veterinary clinic that prioritizes animal welfare over profit.

A very reputable veterinary clinic with professionals who love animals.

I highly recommend them; I've been going there for years for my cats. ✅
The team was exceptionally friendly, helpful, and competent. Payment plans of 3 or 4 installments are available (fees apply).

I realize now that I'm looking for a good vet in my new city, which is why I didn't leave a review to help others in the same situation! I have a very positive opinion of this veterinary clinic. My dogs were treated by Doctors Dagnac and Bellmann, who were both impeccable, and all the staff I encountered were perfectly friendly and professional. (I had actually met Dr. Dagnac at a previous clinic and was happy to see her again!) They were always attentive, efficient, and transparent about the effects and costs of procedures and treatments (and their alternatives when available). I felt confident every time I went; my dogs were very well cared for. Personally, I had the kind of experience I wish I had with any vet.

I find it difficult to understand why an ultrasound was performed without any images being saved or made available afterward.

As the owner, I expected a minimum level of documentation and medical follow-up for my cat, especially after a visit to the emergency vet during a busy weekend.
This situation leaves me feeling very disappointed with the professionalism of the care provided.

The vets, both men and women, are very kind and know how to care for our kittens and dogs.
Personally, I'm satisfied. They gave the kittens their vaccinations and are understanding about their care. They love everyone, even the receptionists, who are very friendly and kind.
What can I say? A competent team of veterinarians.
Excellent clinic that welcomed me and my cat very well without an appointment. Thank you to Dr. Laurie Dagnac, who was very kind and friendly.

Very satisfied with the surgical procedures performed by Dr. Dagnac, including the spaying and other treatments for my little cat... the clinic is also very competitive in terms of prices.

I recommend them 100%.
Very professional

My dog ​​and I received a very warm welcome. She was seen by a very professional and gentle woman, and the visit and vaccination went very well. In short, I found my go-to place for veterinary care, where I received helpful advice without being pressured to buy anything extra.
She wanted to put my dog ​​down for nothing, the vet dodged it, he just had an infection, she said it was a tumor, luckily I went to a great vet in the 9th arrondissement.
Dishonest vets who make you believe your cat has a heart problem, then send you to one of their colleagues…

This is the best veterinary team in Marseille. They take great care of the animals and do everything they can for their well-being. The team is professional, friendly, and very compassionate. They are always available without long waits and offer excellent advice, even over the phone; they are very responsive. A special thank you to Emilie for saving my little Sissi despite her very delicate condition. The follow-up care is regular, with reminders even by mail, which is much appreciated. Thank you again; I highly recommend this veterinary center. ❤️ 🐾
Top-notch vets and staff, digitally speaking, for my dog ​​and my 4 cats
Excellent clinic, very conscientious and attentive veterinarian, I highly recommend it.

I made an appointment for my cat's sterilization and what a pleasure to see a dedicated team, a full office early in the morning with people very satisfied with the clinic and thank you for the welcome and all the good advice you gave me, I will come back if ever and I will recommend it to everyone I know.

Fantastic team. Pleasant welcome. Clean premises.
Attentive staff 5/5
Dr. Dagnac is a very good veterinarian; go there if you are well received.

I went there on a friend's recommendation, and my cat was seen immediately.
The staff are excellent and attentive to the animal patients.

My first dog was taken care of there, and until today, nothing lasted. I called about my baby Chihuahua, who can stand up well but is having trouble breathing. I called, and they told me, "Don't you have a doctor?" Well, no, it's only until 7 PM, you're finishing up. They don't want to bother. If something happens to my dog, be prepared, I'm telling you, run away! Seriously, to make money, you're happy, ignoring them everywhere. I'm going to expose you, don't go there under any circumstances.

I went to see Dr. Bouroudian for the first time, for a second opinion regarding a right ureteral obstruction in my son Maxou.
She was incredibly honest, clear, patient, and caring.
She supported me as best she could in making this dreaded decision.
Max was suffering, and I had to free him.
The entire team was wonderful, gave me time to say goodbye, and allowed me the choice of being with him until the very end. In my sadness, I can only recommend that you go see them.
Thank you, Doctor, thank you, Manu, thank you, Inès. Don't change a thing about your humanity, your empathy, and your kindness.
I highly recommend this clinic. Dr. Bruno Bellmann was very gentle and put my dog, who had an eye problem, at ease. He was seen as an emergency and provided excellent care.
I've known them since I got my dog, they're truly wonderful vets with hearts of gold ❤️❤️
My cat has cancer, she's suffering, it's expensive to euthanize her.

We've been taking our two dogs—an American Staffordshire Terrier and a terrier/pinscher mix—to this clinic for their vaccinations for the past three years.

Two weeks ago, we had to take the Amstaff in for an emergency due to a severe allergic reaction.

The veterinarians and assistants are available, friendly, competent, and reassuring.

And they love animals!
Highly recommended.

The Most Humane Clinic

From the staff and their values ​​to their way of doing things, everything is perfect.

In the past, I've been to several different clinics, and this is the only one that has truly impressed me. You can see that they love their work and that they prioritize the health of the animals above all else, not their own profit.

Yesterday, I found a stray cat, in poor condition and very sick, in my building. So I decided to take it to the Saint-Antoine clinic.

The team didn't keep us waiting in the waiting room for ages and acted quickly, despite the presence of several other patients.

After explaining the situation and specifying that the cat didn't belong to us, they covered the animal's medical expenses.
I thank their entire team again for their work, their kindness, and their generosity.
For an emergency or even a simple vaccination, they're the best. Go for it with your pets!

Thank you to the doctors and staff of this clinic for their care, attention, kindness, and respect for our beloved animals 🙏 I am Tinky's mom, to whom we had to say goodbye on March 21st, after 16 years of happiness, joy, and loyalty that he brought us...♥️♥️ …

I brought my two kittens in for spaying/neutering, and it went very well. The team is excellent. They are gentle and attentive with the animals. I highly recommend them; the team is professional and friendly, and the reception is very well organized and the staff is also very kind! Thank you!

💔💔💔💔First time, I brought my cat Nina back to the vet after she gave birth to a stillborn kitten. The vet told me she had necrosis and another dead kitten. She asked for €350, which I didn't have. I called the animal shelter urgently, and they took her in. 48 hours later, there was no necrosis, no dead kitten. She had also contracted an ear infection that the vet at St. Antoine didn't notice. I brought my kitten Zénice, my beloved 8-month-old baby, back for neutering, which the vet was supposed to do. He died 1 to 2 minutes after the injection to put him to sleep. 💔💔💔💔💔💔 For two years I'd wanted his beautiful three different shades of gray, and my baby is dead. I'm so disgusted. I should never have taken him to that vet clinic. My heart is broken. My Jul is looking for him everywhere; he can see him clearly. I miss my Zeilzeil, they were always together. I will never go to that clinic again. 1600 people agree with me on Facebook. Several told me to file a complaint. 💔💔💔💔💔💔💔😥😥😥😥😥😥😥😥😥😥💔💔💔💔💔💔💔💔
The veterinarian and reception staff were very kind, thank you all.
The vet was very kind and excellent with my dog ​​Cookie, a little Chihuahua, who was visiting for the first time.
Friendly and helpful team.
Awesome, thank you!
Good veterinarians
A fantastic team, I highly recommend them.
Excellent service, dedicated and competent team. Very attentive and they do their best to schedule a quick appointment in case of emergency. In short, I highly recommend them ;)
It went very well! A pleasant and attentive team.
Very good, very clean, easy to access
Competent staff. It's a shame they don't have more equipment for examining certain pathologies.

0 stars. My dog ​​was in perfect health. I had an appointment for his leishmaniasis booster. The vet gave him the booster, but as I was leaving, she told me she'd given him the wrong vaccine and that I should bring him back in three weeks for the correct one.
My dog ​​started losing weight, and I had to take him to another vet who put him in intensive care and on an IV drip. He passed away this morning. Avoid this veterinary clinic if you want to keep your pet alive! I shouldn't have vaccinated him; he would still be alive.
A top-notch team! Combining professionalism, competence, kindness, and empathy.

I was truly impressed by the kindness and professionalism of this veterinarian, Dr. Emilie Barroudian.

She also gives excellent advice and explains things very well.

She takes the time to reassure the animal. I recommend her without hesitation. Payment plans are available with a credit card that accepts them.

I absolutely love Dr. Bellmann; I wouldn't go anywhere else for my cats! I've never seen a vet so attentive, gentle, and honest! Plus, the reception team is fantastic. I highly recommend this practice without hesitation!
Rosa and Pitch's mom ♥️
What can I say? Just BRAVO! Dr. Bellmann is so gentle with animals; he knows how to talk to them and explain things properly. …
